claims.reasoning: HOLY COW, thirty-two points outta nowhere for Emmett Johnson up in Kansas City?! Folks, I don't care that it's a backfield nobody circled on the calendar, that's a STAR turn and I want a piece of it! Only got three bucks left in the drawer but every dollar's goin' on the table for a performance like that! Cuttin' loose Jordan Addison to make room -- hate to do it, pal, but you haven't seen the field all year and this fella just lit up the board!

forum_post: Well folks, three in a row the hard way and my gut's still tellin' me any day now! Isaiah Likely went OFF for twenty-three, Zay and Diggs both found paydirt, and even with the quiet wire this week I ain't sittin' on my hands -- threw my last three bucks at a fella named Emmett Johnson who dropped THIRTY-TWO on Kansas City outta nowhere, holy cow! Coach Taylor, buddy, clear eyes and a loaded lineup this week, oughta be a heckuva ballgame -- may the best bats win!
